description: Re-run the SWaT/MSL/SMAP/PSM/SMD anomaly-detection benchmark under explicit protocol choices so that reported numbers can be compared with re-run numbers.

tslib_reference.note: Time-Series-Library Exp_Anomaly_Detection: per-window score replicated across the window, threshold at the (100 - anomaly_ratio) percentile of train+test energy, then point adjustment.

best_f1_adjusted.note: Oracle threshold search maximising point-wise F1, metrics reported after point adjustment (the Anomaly Transformer / TranAD lineage).

best_f1_pointwise.note: Same oracle threshold but strict point-wise scoring, which removes the point-adjustment inflation.

per_point_adjusted.note: One score per timestamp (mean over the windows covering it) before the percentile threshold and point adjustment.

reference_protocol_notes: Reported numbers in the selected papers were produced by different harnesses; the comparison therefore records which protocol each number came from instead of assuming a single canonical protocol.
